name: overnight_gap_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY opens with a 0.3-1.0% gap vs the previous close, the gap is produced by SGX Nifty futures and thin pre-market participation rather than genuine intraday price discovery. VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks (domestic MFs, FIIs) receive fill prices materially worse than their expected intraday VWAP at the open and immediately initiate counter-directional orders to exploit the mispricing, creating a systematic directional flow toward the gap fill within the first 20-30 minutes. At 5-second resolution we detect when the short-term RSI signals exhaustion of the opening spike (RSI below 40 for gap-down, above 60 for gap-up) and price is still away from session VWAP, then enter in the direction of the institutional reversion pressure to capture the next 30-120 second leg of this flow.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Overnight gap magnitude derived from first bar's open vs previous day's last close. No scaling needed — it is a fixed daily quantity known at 09:15:00 for the entire session. Threshold 0.3-1.0%: below 0.3% the gap is noise, above 1.0% the gap is likely macro/news-driven and may not revert within our window.

indicators.name: rsi_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute RSI (12 bars × 5s = 60s). Original used RSI(14) on 1-min bars as a 14-minute exhaustion measure. We compress to 1-minute because we are trading 30-120 second holds and need exhaustion at the same timescale. RSI<40 on gap-down confirms the first 1-minute leg of selling has tired; RSI>60 on gap-up confirms the first 1-minute leg of buying is stretched — both signal the institutional counter-flow is about to assert.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: VWAP(high, low, close, volume) cumulative from 09:15 each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative from day open — no scaling needed. Used as a proximity check: gap-down entry requires close < VWAP (still below benchmark, gap not yet filled); gap-up entry requires close > VWAP. This prevents entries after the gap has already filled and removes the need to track gap_filled boolean.

conditions: rsi_12 < rsi_oversold (default 40) — 1-min exhaustion of down move
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions true simultaneously on a 5-second bar

conditions: rsi_12 > rsi_overbought (default 60) — 1-min exhaustion of up move
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions true simultaneously on a 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points adverse move. A genuine gap-fill institutional flow should not reverse by 8 spot points within 30 seconds — if it does, the flow has exhausted or reversed. NIFTY 30-second moves average 2-5 pts; an 8 spot point reversal is a 2-sigma adverse event indicating the thesis is wrong.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points toward gap fill. A 0.3-0.5% gap on NIFTY ~22000 is 66-110 points; capturing 14 spot points is 13-20% of the full gap — realistic for a 30-120 second entry into the first institutional leg. NIFTY 1-2 minute moves in a directional context run 5-10 option pts; 7 is the midpoint with 1:1.75 R:R.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 09:50 IST (end of gap window)

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — in high volatility regimes, gaps are news-driven and gap-fill probability drops sharply
filters.time_filter: 09:20-09:50 IST only — gap fill pressure concentrates in first 30 minutes; after 09:50 the session VWAP reanchors and the gap signal is stale
filters.volume_filter: none explicitly — NIFTY index volume at open is reliably high; VWAP proximity serves as implicit flow confirmation
filters.trend_filter: gap_max_pct=1.0% cap — gaps > 1% are macro/event-driven (RBI, budget, global shock) and will not fill within our window
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — structural: VWAP benchmarking by institutional desks is a persistent feature of Indian equity market microstructure

adaptation_notes: Original traded individual Nifty50 stocks (top 30 by turnover) on 1-min bars with 15-75 minute holds, targeting full gap fill (prev_day_close). Converted to NIFTY index on 5-sec bars with 30-120 second holds targeting partial gap fill. Key changes: (1) Universe collapsed from 30 stocks to 1 index — index gaps are smoother, driven by SGX futures not stock-specific news; (2) RSI compressed from 14-min to 1-min to match 5s hold time; (3) VWAP replaces gap_filled boolean — cleaner signal for whether institutional counter-flow has started; (4) Time window compressed from 09:15-10:45 to 09:20-09:50 — gap fill pressure on NIFTY concentrates in first 30 minutes before midday drift takes over; (5) Target changed from full gap fill to partial (7 pts vs 66-110 spot pt full gap) — realistic for 120-second hold; (6) Stock-specific filters removed (delivery %, event filter per stock, spread filter) — not applicable to index.
weaknesses: Gap fires once per day — low trade frequency (0-2 per day) in the 30-minute window
NIFTY gap might close in first few 5-second bars before RSI confirms, missing the entry window
Global macro shocks can produce gaps > 1% that are correctly filtered but reduce signal frequency on volatile days
On expiry days, gap dynamics can be distorted by options pinning near round numbers — should ideally filter expiry days
Day-1 of dataset has no prev_day_close — no trades generated on first day
